changes.summary: Optional boolean on DataAction tools controls whether call and result stay in conversation context when older turns are pruned.
Optional boolean marks dependency-only inputs; must be true for Knowledge tool inputs that gate on prior tool output.
Computed marker records whether each tool explicitly set context_retention_enabled so plan can distinguish omitted from false.
Description now covers DataAction and Knowledge tools and documents dependency_only requirements for Knowledge tools.
Description now states validation applies to DataAction and Knowledge tools.
Plan and refresh treat omitted context_retention_enabled separately from false and skip consistency-check diffs for omitted API values and the presence marker.
Create and update build tool payloads from raw configuration so optional nested booleans match declared configuration.
Export omits context_retention_enabled when the API value is unset and uses version listing cache when resolving agent_id.
Auto-created status settings run only when open_status_default or closed_status_auto_terminate are explicitly in configuration, not from values read into state on refresh.
Same explicit-configuration behavior as open_status_default for closed status auto-terminate settings.
Diff suppression for disable_default_status_creation applies only after the resource exists so create still sends the configured value.
When disable_default_status_creation is true, create and update skip Open/Closed auto-status configuration.
Failed post-create status configuration triggers deletion of the new worktype and clears state ID.
Export excludes open_status_default and closed_status_auto_terminate; those settings appear on worktype status resources.
Workbin list queries omit empty after cursor on the first page so export enumeration succeeds.
Workbin and workitem list queries omit empty after cursor on the first page during export-related listing.
Worktype list queries omit empty after cursor on the first page during export enumeration.
Export discovers greetings with concurrent per-user pagination, skips 403 permission errors, and uses the user exporter user list.
ID-filtered exports can fetch only named callable time set IDs instead of listing the entire org.
ID-filtered exports can fetch only named call analysis response set IDs instead of listing the entire org.
ID-filtered exports can fetch only named contact list IDs instead of listing the entire org.
ID-filtered exports can fetch only named contact list filter IDs instead of listing the entire org.
ID-filtered exports can fetch only named DNC list IDs instead of listing the entire org.
ID-filtered exports can fetch only named queue IDs instead of listing every queue in the org.
Export resolves asset_ids references to genesyscloud_responsemanagement_responseasset.
ID-filtered exports load only requested users with standard expands and inactive or deleted filtering instead of full org listing.
Provider proxy settings and HTTP(S)_PROXY env vars apply to file download, upload, S3, and related HTTP operations used during apply and export.
